summary: Iteration 111 - 365-Day Market Demand Dashboard & Dynamic Pricing Expansion Testing Complete. All 17 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI fully verified: Market Demand dashboard shows dark theme with 8 KPIs, FLOWCAST chart, Rate Grid table with all required columns, and nights selector (30/60/90/180/365). AI Dynamic Pricing has nights selector with 365-day support. Smart Scanner shows 7 tiers including 3-6 months and 6-12 months. Market Robot has 11 sub-tabs including new Market Demand tab.

tests: Dark theme header with 'Market Demand & Rates' title
8 KPI cards: Days, Avg Occupancy, Avg Rate, Base Rate, High Demand, Low Demand, Event Days, AI Managed
FLOWCAST chart showing occupancy bars + AI rate dots + min rate dashed line
Rate Grid table with columns: Date, Day, AI Status, ADR, Occupancy, Min Rate, Floor Rate, Sell Rate, Target Rate, Market, Event
Grid title shows selected range (e.g., '365-Day AI Price Recommendations')
Calculate button works for all day ranges

critical_code_review_comments: Demand dashboard endpoint correctly returns daily_data for requested days (30/60/90/180/365)

Each daily_data entry includes all required fields: date, dow, occupancy, market_unavail, demand_level, base_rate, ai_rate, sell_rate, min_rate, floor_rate, target_rate, ai_status, event, event_impact
ai_status correctly set based on set_by field: ai (ai-dynamic-pricing/auto-scanner), event (event-intelligence), manual (market-robot), base (no override)
Dynamic pricing calculate endpoint supports 365-day range
Smart Scanner has 7 tiers covering full year: 0-2d, 2-7d, 7-14d, 14-28d, 28-90d, 90-180d, 180-365d
Frontend MarketDemandDashboard.js uses proper data-testid attributes
FLOWCAST chart renders occupancy bars with demand-based coloring and AI rate dots
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Using existing rate_overrides and market_supply data from previous iterations.
